newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD SIGN HUNGARIAN GOALKEEPER PETRY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD SIGN HUNGARIAN GOALKEEPER PETRY.

text.p: Dutch first division Feyenoord have signed Hungarian international goalkeeper Zsolt Petry to replace Ed de Goey who is moving to English premier league Chelsea, Dutch newspaper Algemeen Dagblad reported on Friday.
Petry, 30, has appeared 40 times for his country. His contract with Belgian first division team Charleroi ended last season.
Petry will compete with Poland's Jerzy Dudek for the position of first-choice goalkeeper at Feyenoord.
Chelsea are reported to have paid Feyenoord seven million guilders ($3.6 million) for De Goey, who has earned 29 international caps.
